title: Low Simmered Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A spicy and romantic Uruguayan dish featuring umeboshi, this low simmered beef stew is a light and flavorful meal option, friendly to low glycemic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the beef cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the pitted umeboshi plums and enough water to cover the ingredients, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
